# Magical Effect

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Spells and Magic](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#MagicalEffect)*

An effect is magical if it is created by a spell, a magic item, or a phenomenon that a rule labels as magical.
